scope: Four-entry bioRxiv pilot, fail-closed production route; no bibliography edits.

negative_control.finding: API returns v1 new results and v2 withdrawn with unchanged title. The complete version history, not title alone, detects withdrawal. Control stays outside the bibliography/main cache.

LeeEtal19.method: Local PDF physical first-page image visually inspected, independently of API/HTML parsing.
LeeEtal19.observed: Printed header: bioRxiv DOI 10.1101/615203, version posted April 22 2019. Complete title and Jae Sung Lee, John Briguglio, Sandro Romani, Albert K. Lee agree with API, version-page metadata and DOI registry. The later Cell paper has a different DOI and is not substituted.

FoxEtal14.method: Independently read visible title/byline in fetched repository HTML, plus its explicit date and DOI head metadata; no local PDF available.
FoxEtal14.observed: Full title Bridging psychology and genetics using large-scale spatial analysis of neuroimaging and neurogenetic data. Andrew S. Fox, Luke J. Chang, Krzysztof J. Gorgolewski, Tal Yarkoni in order. Posted 2014-12-09, DOI 10.1101/012310, v1. All existing citation fields match. Web reader returned 403; paced CLI retrieval returned 200 and supplied the saved source.

ZimaMann21.finding: Visible repository byline and Crossref both put Kirsten Ziman before Jeremy R. Manning, agreeing with the bibliography. API lists Manning first. Hold source conflict; do not change a correct bibliography to match the API.

GoldEtal21.finding: API returns four versions spanning 2020 and 2021. Citation has no explicit version, and the registry byline differs from version metadata. Held pending source-version adjudication.
